title: Work
purpose: Shows the list of jobs for Claude and when they run, and sets the night run, the day run and Run now.
description: Keeps one line of jobs for Claude. A job runs only when Claude's weekly allowance is far enough under its pace. In the day the pace must be well under. At night it can be closer. One job runs at a time. The Runs card sets when the add-on queues the to-do list on its own: a night run, a day run, and a Run now button, each with a pace target and a number of items (or unlimited). You change individual jobs on the Agents dashboard. The add-on starts in test mode: it keeps the line but hands out nothing.
navigation: Keeps one line of jobs, first in, first out
Hands a job out only when the pace allows it
Takes the job back if its helper goes quiet
Starts in test mode and hands out nothing
Runs the to-do list at night and by day, or on demand, up to a pace target and a number of items
